sources.scope: Seven predeclared original English raster/geometry/accuracy fixtures plus separately declared layout order.
Four actual original C-API observations on one predeclared raster; no SDK host qualification.
Explicit caller-provisioned English model, no implicit model lookup/download.

decisions: Preserve the immutable original and retain opt-in parameters; nearest-neighbor corrections have explicit pixel-edge inverse transforms.
Explicit vertical-curvature bilinear grids use nonfolding columns. Nonlinear word boundaries split at grid crossings and bound quadratic chord error before allocation.

Orientation/skew confidence gaps and layout evidence scores are not correctness probabilities. Table/form semantic hints are caller authority; detected closed grids retain unresolved semantics/raw order.
Processed DPI remains the nominal source OCR hint; inverse geometry carries physical mapping. Full automatic curve/general-deformation/semantic profiles remain mandatory.
